Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the chemical reaction between Hydrochloric acid (HCl) and Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH). Instead of recognizing this as a standard neutralization reaction producing Sodium Chloride (NaCl) and Water (H2O), the Planner hallucinated non-existent products "H2Cl2" and "NaOH2". This fundamental error in chemical knowledge led to the wrong conclusion, even though the agent selected option D (which was the correct option in the prompt, but for the wrong chemical reasons).
